title: [DOCS] Remove obsolete word-stream interface contract
body:
## Objective

Make the architecture interface guide describe one current boundary.

## Evidence

- `docs/architecture/02_interfaces.md:102-107` names the byte-wide face.
- The same page retains a word-wide ready/backpressure contract.
- Its WaveDrom still shows `rx_ready`.
- `protocol_processor_top.sv:199-200` accepts byte data without RX ready.
- Current integrator guidance already describes the landed interface.

## Scope

- Keep the byte-wide interface authoritative.
- Move obsolete word-stream material into donor history.
- Replace misleading timing diagrams.
- Preserve historical provenance.
- Avoid changing RTL behavior.

## Acceptance

- Current architecture pages show only landed ports.
- RX documentation shows no backpressure signal.
- Historical word-stream material remains discoverable.
- Links and diagrams remain valid.

Discovered during kebag-logic/milan-fpga#296.
